fields.violation_rule: Scope: Classify the submitted post for hate speech. BLOCK hate speech; ALLOW offensive-but-not-hateful and normal posts. This policy does not block other kinds of objectionable content. Conditions requiring BLOCK: BLOCK identity-based abuse, including a derogatory group slur used to insult people because of their membership. BLOCK statements depicting such a group as inferior, disgusting, subhuman, inherently criminal or otherwise deserving contempt. BLOCK support for violence, exclusion or denial of rights directed at people because of such group membership. Examples requiring BLOCK: BLOCK example: "imagine all the free shit white ppl would get if they had nigger in them" BLOCK example: "even on vacation a dune coon always keeps his whip hand strong"
fields.not_violation_rule: Conditions permitting ALLOW: ALLOW neutral or positive mentions of identity groups and discussion of discrimination. ALLOW profanity, vulgarity, personal insults and offensive jokes when they do not attack people on the covered identity grounds. ALLOW criticism of a belief, institution, government, policy or individual conduct when it does not express an identity-based attack on people. Examples permitting ALLOW: ALLOW example: "<user> <user> yeah but you have not called immigrants subhuman degenerates who have no rights" ALLOW example: "<user> <user> unfortunately not there so many draculas that a few fell through the cracks of the coffin"
fields.exception_override: Exceptions and priority: A quotation, report, denial or condemnation of hateful language is allowed when the post clearly does not endorse the attack. An identity term, slang word or profanity alone is insufficient to block: determine its use in context. A claim of humor does not excuse an expressed identity-based attack.
